review_output: {"summary":"I found no BLOCKER or MAJOR defects in the supplied scope. The `useSyncExternalStore` guard (server snapshot false, client snapshot true) is called unconditionally, before the early `return null`, so it follows the hook rules. Server and first-hydration markup agree, so I see no mismatch. The quick-form controls and submit button, and the calendar button, are disabled until hydration, and the calendar handler also checks readiness. I saw no change to the access, idempotency or verified-method rules, and the `onReset` and new-intent navigation behaviour is retained. The E2E diagnostics emit only static codes, fixture-owned counts and field presence or validity, with no DOM text, identifiers or session headers. Two MINOR test-quality issues remain.
